summary.zh: 满本堂是清代内阁缮写满文奏章的办事机构。故宫博物院官网记其房屋在蒙古堂以南，三间，南向面城垣；同页词解记“原在内阁大堂院内，现不存”。
summary.en: Manben Hall was a Qing Grand Secretariat office for copying memorials in Manchu. The Palace Museum website describes it as a three-bay building south of the Mongolian office, facing south toward the city wall. Its glossary states that it formerly stood in the Neige Main Hall courtyard and no longer survives.

evidenceNote.zh: 本条转述官网记述的历史房屋；“现不存”是来源原文，不等于本轮对2026年现场存续的独立核验。拆除年代、完整形体及尺寸未核定。
evidenceNote.en: This entry reports the historical building described on the museum website. “No longer survives” is the source’s statement, not an independent verification of site conditions in 2026. Its demolition date, complete form and dimensions remain unverified.

modelNote.en: This is an information-only entry. No independent model or map position is bound, and direct travel is unavailable.
